entries.title: QuakeRally 1.2
entries.author: Impact Development Team
entries.description: The complete Quake 1 mod package. Start here if you want to explore the original QuakeRally.
entries.requires: Quake 1. This is a mod, not a standalone game.
entries.note: Includes a historical launcher. Compatibility with current engines has not been tested.
entries.evidence: RALLY/PROGS.DAT reports v1.2. The ZIP includes the main data, maps and RALLY/QRDOCS.TXT.
entries.rights: The historical documentation restricts sale, CD-ROM distribution and use of the assets in other products. No blanket open-source licence is claimed for the models, textures or music. See the original documentation.

entries.title: QuakeRally: Leftovers
entries.author: Impact Development Team
entries.description: The final release: more maps, vehicle replacements and unfinished material from Ultimate Rally.
entries.requires: An existing QuakeRally 1.2 installation and Quake 1.
entries.note: Replaces existing files and vehicles. Released without support by the original team.
entries.evidence: rally/leftovers.txt is dated 3/98, calls this the final release, and explicitly requires QuakeRally v1.2. PROGS.DAT reports v1.2b.
entries.rights: The historical documentation restricts sale, CD-ROM distribution and use of the assets in other products. No blanket open-source licence is claimed for the models, textures or music. See the original documentation.

entries.title: QuakeRally 1.0

entries.description: The early full mod release, preserved in its original self-extracting archive wrapper.
entries.requires: Quake 1.
entries.note: The outer ZIP contains qr10full.exe, a self-extracting ZIP container. It was inspected without running the executable.
entries.evidence: The nested ZIP has 22 entries including the main PAKs, maps and QRDOCS.TXT. PROGS.DAT reports v1.0.
entries.rights: The historical documentation restricts sale, CD-ROM distribution and use of the assets in other products. No blanket open-source licence is claimed for the models, textures or music. See the original documentation.

entries.title: Early QuakeRally recorded demos
